answer: A mesa-bridge split-tally bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and splits its tally in two: one half stays on mesa board, the other crosses a bridge, one serial and epoch. Auditors join halves by serial; halves that disagree, or a serial reused, burn the bond. A tally below the nadir of 60 is rejected; rented tallies fail. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 for at most 40,000 reward. Honest agents pay 40 once.
